main.description: A note within a wiki. The rkey is a TID. Human-readable slug lives in the record body.

slug.description: Permanent human-readable identifier, used in URLs. Never changes once set.

title.description: Display name for the note. Can be updated freely.

navTitle.description: Optional label shown in the wiki sidebar and quick nav. When omitted, clients use title.

wikiRef.description: AT-URI of the parent wiki record.

subheaderLinks.description: Page-specific subheader navigation links shown under the page title.

headerLink.description: A single custom header navigation link.

url.description: Internal note slug/path, or an absolute URL. Optional: a link may exist as a label and image with no destination yet.

image.description: Optional icon image shown above or beside the label.
